text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper focuses on integrated modelling of Climate, Land-use, Energy, and Water Systems (CLEWS) primarily from an energy sector perspective for Mauritius. It does not have a primary focus on land use land cover (LULC) future prediction or simulation. Although land-use is considered, it is as part of a broader integrated resource assessment rather than as the central research question. The paper does not implement multiple future LULC scenarios with quantitative spatial modeling and accuracy metrics focused on LULC prediction. Instead, it uses land-use modeling to inform energy system assessments and interdependencies. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criterion of primary focus on LULC prediction and spatial LULC projections, and is excluded.)
